title: a feature redefining the inherited feature of the same name
note: FIXED 2026-09-03 (I4). KerML §8.2.3.5.1 resolves a redefinition against the GENERALS of the owning type, not by ordinary name resolution — which would answer with the redefining feature itself. `part w :>> w;` used to build a Redefinition from `P::Car::w` to itself; it now targets `P::Base::w`.
